blockers.wanted: a slowly moving wind speed in a loop that passes loop_seam at every seed
blockers.tried: wander (range 6..16, rate 0.33) into wind.speed; loop_seam failed at seed 1 (spectral change 7.1 dB, loudness drifting down 7 LU over the sound)
blockers.workaround: two sine lfos at 1/6 Hz and 1/3 Hz (periodic in the 6 s duration) summed into the speed, plus a crossfade_loop after the filters; seeds 1..6 then pass with spectral change 0.4-1.1 dB

blockers.wanted: gustiness knob that moves the gust field
blockers.tried: macro mapping wind.gust 0.1..1 with claim swing rises; verify FAIL at all seeds (9.1 -> 7.3 LU at seed 1, flat at others)
blockers.workaround: gustiness drives a gain on the periodic speed lfo (swing 1.2 -> 12.9 LU over 0..1)

blockers.wanted: to read only the noise-relevant descriptors
blockers.tried: read density 296 events/s, onsets 1, inharmonic partials 111 cents off: not meaningful for wind noise
blockers.workaround: ignored those lines; used centroid by tenth, steadiness and the spectrogram

blockers.wanted: replace the wander spd by a math node of the same name
blockers.tried: math named spd: error says spd is a wander; delete it first
blockers.workaround: delete op plus new op in the same batch worked (the error was clear)
